scripts/swarm_v2/kubernetes/terminal.py:.reason: Swarm feeds only Endpoint.labels, which with_terminal never reads. TerminalTemplate.render passes this Scope only to Endpoint, and with_terminal reads only endpoint.name, which is pod_name(scope.execution_id) plus -terminal; Scope is a frozen dataclass with no validation and the digest hashes only the pod dict, so the rendered Pod and digest are unchanged.
